title: Fourth Turning Climax: Iran War Only The Beginning... | Neil Howe
speaker: Neil Howe

macro_themes.view: US is in the crisis era, likely climaxing within the next decade, with strongmen and rising interstate conflict; Iran war is a prelude.
Next 10 years will be fundamentally inflationary with financial repression; Fed/Treasury will bail out markets rather than fight inflation.
Fixed income, even TIPS, is a bad place in a crisis era; be out of bonds entirely.
CAPE ~43 implies negative 10-year equity returns; AI boom will bust, chip stocks most vulnerable; tech underperformance is a warning tremor.
Grid and infrastructure attacks are the biggest homeland threat in a coming conflict.

calls.reason: Fund is short long-duration zero-coupon Treasuries; crisis-era inflation and rising term premium make long bonds lose (i.e. long yields higher).
calls.quote: We're not a buyer of long-term bonds at all... right now we're actually short zeros

calls.reason: CAPE over 40 historically gives negative 10-year returns and AI 'this time is different' ends with the market going down, but fund stays long to participate and can't time it.
calls.quote: It always ends with the market goes down. The question is when? You can't time these things.

calls.reason: Chip/DRAM stocks are most vulnerable to any slowdown in data-center growth; fund is short the weakest parts of tech.
calls.quote: private equity and chip stocks is where we're shortest

calls.reason: Private equity is among the fund's largest shorts amid excess leverage and rising real rates.
